column11: No routine vaccination is required for Indian nationals entering Poland. A Yellow Fever vaccination certificate may be required if arriving from or transiting through a WHO-designated risk country.

No routine vaccination is required for Saudi Arabian nationals entering Poland. A Yellow Fever vaccination certificate may be required if arriving from or transiting through a WHO-designated risk country.
No routine health restrictions apply to Polish citizens returning to Poland.

Origin-specific override: Indian nationals transiting via Saudi Arabia en route to Poland must present a valid Meningitis (ACWY) vaccination certificate per transit health screening, in addition to the standard India-to-Poland requirements. Demonstrates origin-aware rule matching; verify against current WHO/Polish MFA guidance before production use.
